scope: Explicit unique-source cohorts and separately counted retained attempts. No single global success rate is inferred from adaptive trials.

cluster.scheduling: Operator-side per-pod leases let concurrent batches share all 50 persistent pods; a busy pod defers a job instead of failing it.
cluster.archive_storage: Operator archives are written by the executing pod to /mnt/reachy-retarget/operator-backups/local-spool-pool and re-read on a second pod; only receipts and logs remain on the operator disk.
cluster.scaling_note: Deployment scaled 50->100 replicas on 2026-10-07 (namespace pod quota 200; required one-pod-per-host anti-affinity). Pods keep a 2-CPU / 4Gi limit; single-threaded jobs run two per pod.

can_all_cohorts.held_out_scope: One earlier held-out policy pass plus two new-cohort source successes under different predeclared policies; not one-policy union rate

publication.attempt_count_scope: Independently verified individual receipts, including incomplete batches; variants are not unique source demonstrations.

limitations: Adaptive success unions are not held-out success-rate estimates.
One held-out Can pass does not establish broad generalization.
Some original-model box failures occur before hand contact due to unchanged source-model passive object/table penetration.
Geometric rejection in a bounded search is not proof of global infeasibility.
Physics success remains absent for BiGym and other nonbox tasks under current validated attempts.
